senses.gloss:
Momahaṇa
son of Prayāgadāsa, grandson of Harivāghala.
--Momahaṇagranthapraśastipata. See below.
--Momahaṇavilāsa. med. wrote in 1412, under Mahmūd Sāh, son of Firoz Sāh. See below. [Page197-b]

Momahaṇagranthapraśastipatra
kāvya. by Momahaṇa, son of Prayāgadāsa. RORI. V. 1097.

Momahaṇavilāsa
med. on disease peculiar to women an. children. by Momahaṇa, son of Prayāgadāsa. Filliozat I. 89. L. 779. RASB. 15.
--C. L. 779. RASB. 15.
